title: Japanese Ramen Noodles
description: A traditional Japanese noodle soup dish made with warm, velvety ramen noodles and savory blanched vegetables.

ingredients.name: Blanched vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bok choy or green onions

instructions: Bring 4 cups of warm water to a boil.
Add 2 tbsp of Japanese miso paste and whisk until dissolved.
Add 2 tbsp of soy sauce and whisk until combined.
Add 1 tsp of sesame oil and stir to combine.
Add sliced ginger and blanched vegetables to the pot.
Cook for 3-5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Add 8 oz of ramen noodles to the pot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in chopped scallions.
